title: Lush named among 11 ‘trailblazers’ supporting women in the workplace
summary: Beauty brand and retailer Lush has been highlighted as a standout company for female employees in the 2026 Women in Work Gender Equity Measure (WiW GEM) Report produced with LinkedIn

extraction.key_fact: 러쉬가 링크드인과 함께 작성된 직장 내 성평등 관련 보고서에서 여성 직원을 지원하는 우수 기업으로 선정되었다.
